name: Paciente no identificado
criteria: select p.patient_id from patient p where p.voided = 0 and exists (select 1 from person_attribute pa join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = '787f1ea9-1792-45e5-9076-699b1a0638cb' and (pa.value in ('not_identified', 'no_identificado') or exists (select 1 from concept c where c.uuid in ('bdb57e2a-d8fd-4e2b-8622-1ba60dcd3024') and (pa.value = c.uuid or pa.value = cast(c.concept_id as char)))))
description: Visible cuando el registro fue creado como paciente no identificado o con identidad no verificada

name: Datos de identidad pendientes
criteria: select p.patient_id from patient p where p.voided = 0 and exists (select 1 from person_attribute pa join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = '787f1ea9-1792-45e5-9076-699b1a0638cb' and (pa.value in ('pending', 'partial', 'not_identified', 'no_identificado') or exists (select 1 from concept c where c.uuid in ('bdb57e2a-d8fd-4e2b-8622-1ba60dcd3024', '37ea79cb-9ae7-4297-8e56-8c374561c73c') and (pa.value = c.uuid or pa.value = cast(c.concept_id as char)))))
description: Visible cuando la identificación del paciente sigue pendiente o parcial

name: Paciente incapaz de comunicarse
criteria: select p.patient_id from patient p where p.voided = 0 and exists (select 1 from person_attribute pa join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = 'ee0fb3c8-0432-4035-97c1-e2315d347310' and (pa.value in ('unconscious', 'comatose', 'disoriented', 'non_verbal') or exists (select 1 from concept c where c.uuid in ('4e494787-86c2-4de6-8c4d-06431f2c4150', 'a2795025-e76b-402c-9b14-3ac358f7be44', '67f75970-ee4b-4e22-8e82-d4cc5e82bb2c', '1cc85da7-fbb0-4f34-8ebd-06106ad971cd') and (pa.value = c.uuid or pa.value = cast(c.concept_id as char)))))
description: Visible cuando el paciente no puede brindar datos o consentimiento por condición de comunicación

name: Requiere responsable
criteria: select p.patient_id from patient p where p.voided = 0 and (exists (select 1 from person_attribute pa join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = '787f1ea9-1792-45e5-9076-699b1a0638cb' and (pa.value in ('not_identified', 'no_identificado') or exists (select 1 from concept c where c.uuid in ('bdb57e2a-d8fd-4e2b-8622-1ba60dcd3024') and (pa.value = c.uuid or pa.value = cast(c.concept_id as char))))) or exists (select 1 from person_attribute pa join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = 'ee0fb3c8-0432-4035-97c1-e2315d347310' and (pa.value in ('unconscious', 'comatose', 'disoriented', 'non_verbal') or exists (select 1 from concept c where c.uuid in ('4e494787-86c2-4de6-8c4d-06431f2c4150', 'a2795025-e76b-402c-9b14-3ac358f7be44', '67f75970-ee4b-4e22-8e82-d4cc5e82bb2c', '1cc85da7-fbb0-4f34-8ebd-06106ad971cd') and (pa.value = c.uuid or pa.value = cast(c.concept_id as char)))))) and not exists (select 1 from relationship r join relationship_type rt on rt.relationship_type_id = r.relationship where r.voided = 0 and r.person_b = p.patient_id and rt.uuid in ('e6be4def-dbc8-462a-8714-53da66903cb8', '8d91a210-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '057de23f-3d9c-4314-9391-4452970739c6', '3501ac02-0fb0-4ced-8a3e-f578f0ff5276')) and not exists (select 1 from person_attribute pa join person_attribute_type pat on pat.person_attribute_type_id = pa.person_attribute_type_id where pa.person_id = p.patient_id and pa.voided = 0 and pat.uuid = '4697d0e6-5b24-416b-aee6-708cd9a3a1db' and trim(pa.value) <> '')
description: Visible para registros antiguos o incompletos que no tienen responsable administrativo registrado
